demo.pdp_description:
A compression tee built for heavy training: sweat-wicking, quick-dry fabric and a cut that hugs the muscle without holding you back.

  • 95% compressed cotton, 5% spandex
  • Flat seams that prevent chafing
  • Reflective BULK print
demo.pdp_review_1: Heavy fabric that doesn't trap sweat — wore it for 3 workouts in a row and it held up.
demo.pdp_review_2: True to size, and the print survived the wash.
demo.pdp_review_3: Really nice, though I wish there were more colors.
demo.tm_text_1: Heavy fabric that doesn't trap sweat — wore it three workouts in a row and it still looks new. Best buy this year.
demo.tm_text_2: Sizes are spot on and shipping took two days. Support answered my exchange question within minutes.
demo.tm_text_3: I recommend them to all my trainees. Stable on heavy lifts and comfortable for cardio.
demo.tm_text_4: The hoodie looks premium and the red details really pop. I wish there were more colors.
demo.tm_text_5: First time ordering online and I got exactly what was in the photos. Even the packaging is a treat.
demo.tm_text_6: Roomy bag with a separate shoe compartment. Two months of daily use and not a scratch.
